reason: Both hypotheses largely restate the cited Cu-coated-W/CPF study and do not establish that a surface-limited plasma pulse can treat buried W–Cu interfaces throughout a bulk composite; their claimed thermal benefit is also uncertain because defect-rich W(Cu) and added boundaries may increase electron scattering. B offers a more specific baseline, but this is offset by the physically problematic suggestion that nitrogen plasma would avoid nitride formation, so neither is clearly superior.
